name: tandem
description: Runs OpenAI Codex as a background worker inside Claude Code: cost-aware model routing, verified delegation, conflict-free parallel jobs and shared project memory.

codex_max_model.title: Codex model ceiling
codex_max_model.description: Highest Codex model Tandem may select (generation first, then family luna<terra<sol<astra).

codex_allowed_models.title: Codex model allow-list
codex_allowed_models.description: Optional comma-separated list of exact Codex model slugs Tandem may use. When set it replaces the ceiling heuristic (use it for models whose names cannot be ranked).

codex_max_effort.title: Codex effort ceiling
codex_max_effort.description: Highest Codex reasoning effort Tandem may select.

claude_max_model.title: Claude subagent ceiling
claude_max_model.description: Highest Claude model allowed for subagents.

max_parallel.title: Parallel Codex jobs
max_parallel.description: Concurrent Codex jobs; 0 = auto from CPU count (1-3).

lean_codex.title: Lean Codex prompts
lean_codex.description: Trim Codex's skill/plugin catalogs from delegated runs (about 35% fewer input tokens).

isolation.title: Write isolation
isolation.description: auto: edit in place, or in an isolated git worktree when another writer holds the paths. worktree: always isolate. inplace: never isolate (overlapping jobs queue).

worktree_links.title: Dependency folders for isolated worktrees
worktree_links.description: Optional comma-separated dependency folders to link into isolated worktrees (off by default). Writable links can modify your real project dependencies. Enable only for trusted tasks; 'none' disables.

verify_isolation.title: Verification isolation
verify_isolation.description: sandbox: run checks (which execute code the job wrote) in the Codex OS sandbox: writes confined to the workspace and temp, no network, scrubbed environment, credential stores unreadable (measured before each check); if that cannot be ensured the check is not run and the job stays unverified. contain: same, but also run when the sandbox fails to deny reading some credential stores. off: run checks unsandboxed with your full privileges.

verify_deny_paths.title: Extra paths checks may not read
verify_deny_paths.description: Optional comma-separated absolute paths (files or small folders holding secrets) added to the built-in credential-store list that sandboxed checks cannot read or write.

objective.title: Routing objective
objective.description: What routing minimizes: balanced (tokens and wall time), tokens, or time.
